seo.title: Services
seo.description: Laboratory diagnostics, vaccine production, research, training and consultancy from the Veterinary Research Institute.

hero.title: Services for the veterinary sector and public health.
hero.lead: Diagnostics, production, research, training and consultancy — an integrated range of technical services.

items.title: Laboratory Diagnostics
items.desc: Comprehensive analyses in virology, bacteriology, parasitology, serology and animal pathology. Reliable results through advanced technology and rigorous methodological validation.

items.title: Vaccine Production
items.desc: Manufacture of autogenous and commercial vaccines, hyperimmune sera and diagnostic reagents for the Angolan and regional veterinary sector.

items.title: Scientific Research
items.desc: Applied research projects in animal health, epidemiology and food security, developed through national and international partnerships.

items.title: Technical Training
items.desc: Capacity-building programmes for veterinary technicians, laboratory staff and agricultural sector professionals across all provinces.

items.title: Quality Control
items.desc: Method validation, internal audits and certification of compliance with international ISO and WOAH (OIE) standards.

items.title: Consultancy and Expert Opinions
items.desc: Issuance of technical opinions and specialised consultancy for public entities, organisations and private partners.
